name: Kotlin
summary: Statically typed language from JetBrains targeting the JVM, JavaScript, WebAssembly and native code, with null-safe types, declaration-site variance, extension functions, data/sealed classes and compiler-supported coroutines. Its K2 compiler front end (FIR) feeds a shared IR used by all back ends.

level_notes.0: One implementation: JetBrains/kotlin (K2 front end = PSI parser + FIR; back ends for JVM bytecode, JS, Wasm and Kotlin/Native via LLVM share the 'IR' tree). The repository is too large for directory listings here, so links point at individual files on master. Coroutine library machinery lives in Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines.
level_notes.1: No ISO/ECMA standard. The Kotlin language specification (kotlinlang.org/spec, source in Kotlin/kotlin-spec) is the normative description of Kotlin/Core; it lags the compiler, so KEEP proposals (Kotlin/KEEP, branch main, files named KEEP-nnnn-*.md) and the compiler define newer features.
level_notes.2: The official documentation at kotlinlang.org/docs is explanatory (guide/tour style) and is filed at level 2; only its keyword table and grammar reference are filed at level 1.
